lines.en: I slide along the wall.
I pass through the wall and back.
My body is half transparent and flickers.
I fly a lap around the house.
Bits flake off me as I drift.
I'm here — and then over there.
I move in jerks.
I drift along the ceiling.
My blade drags and scores the wall.
I drift toward wherever someone is.

lines.zh: 从墙里出来的时候很慢。
lines.en: Coming out of the wall is slow.
I drift past behind you.
I hover, flickering.
Standing still, I'm like a shadow.
My blade points down.
I'm resting inside the wall.
I turn in place, making no sound.
My eyes are two points of light.

lines.zh: 我安安静静的，没有呼吸。
lines.en: I'm perfectly quiet, and I don't breathe.
When I reach out, my hand fades.
I've solidified a little again.
I stop in the air and hold.
Turn around and I'm right here.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，所以你没听见。
lines.en: I don't breathe, so you didn't hear me.

lines.zh: 我的脸已经不太清楚了。
lines.en: My face isn't very clear anymore.
Your sword is too close to me.
I drift past the side of your face.
Walls aren't an obstacle to me.
My blade is in your shadow.

lines.zh: 你退，我就在你退的方向。
lines.en: Retreat, and I'll be in the direction you retreat.
You saw me flicker.

lines.zh: 可我的手已经抬起来了。
lines.en: But my hand has already come up.
I flicker and half of me scatters.
I retreat into the wall.
That left me very cold.
I can't hold my shape.

lines.zh: 我的形状一点点拼回来。
lines.en: My shape knits back together.
I dropped my blade.
My face is gone.
I make no sound — I have none.
I slowly thicken into shape.
I carve your shape into the wall.
That thing smells alive.
The sweet smell pulls at my fingers.
I don't eat, and still I want it.

lines.zh: 那东西有心跳，我听得见。
lines.en: That thing has a heartbeat; I can hear it.
I spread my fingers wide.
It passes through my fingers.
I caught it, then let go.

lines.zh: 我好像在哪里闻过这个。
lines.en: I think I've smelled this somewhere.
I set it down anyway.
I squeeze, and it falls apart.
You pass into me — it's cold.

lines.zh: 我闪了一下，才重新聚起来。
lines.en: I flicker before pulling back together.
That scattered half of me.
I come back around through the wall.
My face crumpled briefly.
I float higher to avoid you.
You touched my blade.
I slowly re-form.

lines.zh: 我碰到你的时候也不舒服。
lines.en: Touching you isn't pleasant for me either.
I retreat — into the wall.
Nothing else is left here.
I remember there were a few others.
They were all struck apart.
I looked inside the walls.
I found nothing.
I press a hand to the wall.
The wall is cold, like my hand.
I try to call, and my throat is empty.
I've circled this room countless times.
I sink slowly into the wall.

lines.zh: 我伸手去拿，手穿了过去。
lines.en: I reach and my hand goes through.
I concentrate, and then I can hold it.
Held too long, it slips through my fingers.
I hold it to my eye; light passes through.
It sits in my palm like nothing at all.
It fell to the floor.
I bend for it and fade again.
I grip it, and half of it drops away.
It falls through me.
I set it on the sill and watch it.
There's breathing over there.
I've come through this wall.
I've fixed on its nape.
The blade tip lines up with its back.
My blade gets there first.
It didn't look back; I'm already close.
I appear behind it.
It turns; I'm still where I was.
This distance will do.
I faded again.
It's running for the stairwell.
I go through the wall to cut it off.
I wait in front of it.
I've raised my blade.
I can't stop this time.
I follow, wall between us.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路穿了个洞。
lines.en: I've opened a hole in your way out.

lines.zh: 它跑到楼上，我也在楼上。
lines.en: It runs upstairs; I'm upstairs too.
I flicker as I drift.
It looks back — I'm behind it.
I press it toward the corner.
It's climbing out the window.
I'm waiting outside for it.
It's retreated back in.
I'm tightening the circle bit by bit.
It has no other way out.
My hands are going cold.
My blade points at it.
It's trembling badly.
I'm one step from it.
It's hidden under the table.
I pass through the tabletop.
It runs fast; I don't have to run.
My blade sweeps across.
The cut was shallow, but it stung.
I pass through it and back.
It shrank from the cold.
I drop from the ceiling.
My hand closes on its shoulder.
It broke free; I'm still here.
My second thrust comes in from the side.
I drive the blade in as deep as it goes.
It went down.
I withdraw, half faded.
I draw my blade back.
I stand and watch it.
I shouldn't feel sorry.
I cut again.
Half a hand thrusts out of the wall.

lines.zh: 我从墙里出来，先出来的是脸。
lines.en: I come out of the wall face first.
My first breath isn't breath.
Fragments are gathering back from everywhere.
These walls are all familiar.
I lift my blade once.
Bits fall from between my fingers.
I cast no shadow on the floor.
I hear someone downstairs.

lines.zh: 我的手一会儿实一会儿虚。
lines.en: My hands go solid, then not.

lines.zh: 我从窗口看了一眼外面。
lines.en: I glance out the window.
The sound is downstairs; I sink toward it.

lines.zh: 穿过门的时候我停了一下。
lines.en: I pause as I pass through the door.

lines.zh: 醒过来时我只剩一把剑。
lines.en: When I wake, all I have left is a sword.

lines.zh: 可我的手知道该做什么。
lines.en: But my hands know what to do.
Fire scatters me into flecks of light.
I fall and break apart.
Water thins me out.
The blast blows me apart completely.
The hole closes slowly and stays open.
A spell has pinned me in place.

lines.zh: 我越来越淡，快看不见了。
lines.en: I keep fading; soon I won't be seen.
Lightning lights me all the way through.
Nothing's left; I scatter away.
